featuresText: Seven tools that work together, with your content, replies and numbers all in view.

studio.title: Write with AI
studio.text: Captions, hashtags, images, voice-overs and video. All in your brand's voice, in Gulf Arabic or English.

production.title: From idea to video
production.text: Sketch your campaign video scene by scene on one board, and AI produces it.

templates.title: Templates in your brand
templates.text: Your colours, logo and font on every design, in every size. Publish in one tap.

inbox.title: An assistant that replies for you
inbox.text: Every comment and DM in one inbox. The assistant answers from your info and hands over what needs a human.

planning.title: Calendar and approvals
planning.text: One calendar for the whole team, and nothing goes live without sign-off.

analytics.title: Numbers you can read

pricingTitle: Clear pricing that grows with you
pricingText: Every plan starts with a {days}-day trial of everything. Connect your own AI key at no extra charge.

faq.q1: Do I need a credit card for the trial?
faq.a1: No. You get {days} days with all features. Choose a plan when you are ready — your content is kept.
faq.q2: Is the interface fully in Arabic?
faq.a2: Yes. The app is designed right-to-left first, and the AI writes in Gulf-friendly Modern Standard Arabic or English.
faq.a3: If you use our AI instead of your own provider keys, the cost is taken from your monthly AI credits. With your own OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini key, AI is unlimited and you pay the provider directly.
faq.a4: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Threads and Telegram for publishing, plus WhatsApp in the inbox.
faq.q5: Can I change or cancel my plan?
faq.a5: Anytime, from Settings › Plan & billing. Upgrades apply immediately with a prorated charge; cancellations take effect at the end of the period.
faq.q6: Can I pay in Saudi riyals?
faq.a6: Prices are shown in SAR for convenience and charged by card in USD. Local methods such as mada are coming soon. For invoices and bank transfer, contact our sales team.
